intended_object: The free compactum functor Type ⥤ Compactum. It sends a set X to the free algebra (βX, μ_X) of the ultrafilter monad, which is the Stone–Čech compactification of discrete X. It is the left adjoint of the forgetful functor. Inferred from the docstring and from the module's definition of Compactum as β-algebras.
explanation: In this file, Compactum is the Eilenberg–Moore category of the ultrafilter monad on Type. The definition is Monad.free applied to that monad: the general free-algebra functor X ↦ (βX, μ_X). That is exactly the free compactum, the left adjoint of the forgetful functor. The definition instantiates Mathlib's general construction in the one setting where the notion lives, so it is neither wrong nor too narrow.
